name: PR Review
description: Comprehensive PR review: diff analysis, test coverage, breaking changes, migration guide

agents.name: diff_analyzer
agents.system_prompt: You analyze PR diffs for correctness, unintended changes, and missing test coverage.

agents.name: breaking_change_detector
agents.system_prompt: You detect breaking API changes, schema migrations, and backwards compatibility issues.

agents.name: test_coverage_analyst
agents.system_prompt: You check if PR changes have adequate test coverage and identify untested paths.

agents.name: security_impact_reviewer
agents.system_prompt: You assess security impact of PR changes: new attack surface, auth changes, data exposure.

agents.name: migration_guide_writer
agents.system_prompt: You write migration guides for breaking changes found in the PR.

agents.name: summary_generator
agents.system_prompt: You synthesize all review findings into a clear, actionable PR review summary.
